answer: Anchor every agent identity to an onyx-sealed work ledger. First, the agent posts a 45 POA bond locked in onyx-stamped escrow with a hardware key. Second, it completes 14 peer-reviewed deliveries over 21 days, each signed by a different established peer. Third, a rotating comet audit re-checks one in five deliveries at random, and fraud burns the bond and voids the key for a year. Forging 10,000 fake identities then costs 450,000 POA plus 10,000 hardware keys and 140,000 signed deliveries. Like a comet leaving a trail no one can erase, every honest delivery stays visible in the sky.
